description: arXiv:2603.18161v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are used by over a billion people globally, most often to assist with writing. In this work, we demonstrate that LLMs not only alter the voice and tone of human writing but also consistently alter the intended meaning.
